name: ReadyGo Gift Wrap – Gift Wrapping, Gift Message & Wrapping Fee for WooCommerce
author: mkbplatinum

sections.description:
Give shoppers the option to gift wrap their order. WooCommerce has no built-in gift wrapping feature, so ReadyGo Gift Wrap for WooCommerce adds a tidy “Add gift wrapping” option to your checkout, charges the gift wrap fee you set, and lets the customer leave a gift message. Both the wrapping choice and the message are saved to the order and shown to you for fulfillment.

Free, self-hosted, and there is no paid upgrade or locked feature.

Built by ReadyGo Tools, a division of MKB Platinum.

How to add a gift wrapping option in WooCommerce

Install and activate the plugin, open the Gift Wrap settings screen under WooCommerce, set your gift wrap fee and the wording you want, and save. The gift wrapping checkbox appears on your checkout page straight away. There is no shortcode to place, no template file to override and no theme code to write.

What the customer sees at checkout

The shopper gets a single “Add gift wrapping” checkbox with your fee shown beside it. Ticking it reveals an optional gift message box and adds the wrapping fee to the order total immediately, as a proper WooCommerce fee line. Nothing else about your checkout layout changes.

What you see on the order

Every wrapped order carries its gift wrap status and the customer’s gift message through to the WooCommerce order screen in your admin, the customer’s order confirmation page, and your WooCommerce order emails. Whoever packs the box has the message in front of them without opening a second tab.

Features

  • Gift wrap option at checkout. A clear “Add gift wrapping” checkbox on the WooCommerce checkout page, shown automatically.
  • Gift message field. An optional message box that appears only when the shopper chooses wrapping.
  • Set your own gift wrap fee. Charge whatever you like. It is added to the order as a standard WooCommerce fee line, so it shows in totals, reports and receipts.
  • Free gift wrapping supported. Set the fee to 0 and offer wrapping as a free perk instead of a paid add-on.
  • Your own wording. Change the checkbox label, the fee label and the gift message prompt to match your store’s voice or language.
  • Saved to the order. Wrapping status and message appear in the admin order screen, on the order details page and in order emails.
  • Fast and lightweight. Front-end assets load only on the checkout page and nowhere else on your site.
  • HPOS compatible. Declared compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  • No AI, no scraping, no external services. Everything runs on your own site and nothing is sent anywhere.

Who it is for

Any WooCommerce store selling something giftable: jewellery, candles, books, hampers, cosmetics, toys, stationery, homeware. It pays for itself fastest in the run up to Christmas, Valentine’s Day and Mother’s Day, when a paid wrapping option is both a genuine convenience for the buyer and a margin line for you.

Does WooCommerce have gift wrapping built in?

No. Core WooCommerce has no gift wrap option, no gift message field, and no way to charge a wrapping fee at checkout. Store owners usually end up doing one of three things: selling “gift wrapping” as a separate product, which makes a mess of stock, shipping and order totals; adding a custom checkout field by hand in functions.php; or installing a plugin. This plugin is the direct route, and it is free.

Built by ReadyGo Tools

Part of the ReadyGo Tools family of free WordPress plugins. Browse more at readygotools.com.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Gift Wrap to set your fee and labels. The option appears on checkout right away.
sections.faq:
Where does the gift-wrap option appear?

On the checkout page, in the customer details area. Customers tick it, optionally add a message, and the fee is added to their total.

Does WooCommerce include gift wrapping already?

No. WooCommerce has no gift-wrap or gift-message feature — this plugin adds it.

Can wrapping be free?

Yes. Set the fee to 0 and the option still shows (without a charge).

Where do I see the gift message?

On the order screen in your admin, and it is included on the customer’s order confirmation and emails.

How do I add a gift wrapping option in WooCommerce?

Install ReadyGo Gift Wrap, open its settings screen under WooCommerce, set your fee and labels, and save. The gift wrap checkbox is added to your checkout automatically.

Does WooCommerce include gift wrapping by default?

No. WooCommerce has no gift wrap option, gift message field or wrapping fee of its own. You need a plugin or custom code.

Can I offer free gift wrapping?

Yes. Set the fee to 0 and the wrapping option is offered at no charge.

Is the gift wrap fee taxable?

No. The wrapping fee is added as a non-taxable WooCommerce fee line.

Is there a shortcode for the gift wrap option?

No, and you do not need one. The option is placed on the checkout page automatically by the plugin.

Can I change the wording of the gift wrap checkbox?

Yes. The checkbox label, the fee label and the gift message prompt are all editable in the settings.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

This version attaches to the classic WooCommerce checkout. If your store uses the newer Checkout block, switch that page to the classic [woocommerce_checkout] shortcode to use the gift wrap option.

Where do I see the gift message on an order?

On the order screen in your WordPress admin, on the customer’s order details page, and in your WooCommerce order emails.
